explication: LLaVA-NeXT is a multimodal vision-language model project supporting image, video, multi-image/interleaved inference, evaluation, and fine-tuning; the release notes also describe LLaVA-Critic-R1 training with GRPO. The main flow is user input through serving or evaluation, image/video preprocessing, multimodal model inference, and a generated answer. Separate branches represent supervised/DPO training and EasyR1 distributed RL training, plus the bundled TRL training library. Connections reflect README statements and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled modules are represented only where the tree or documented capabilities supports them.
